chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from Abu Ayoub, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
"What is your view of the Words of Allah, Mighty and Majestic: 'Those who keep aloof from the great sins and the immoralities except for the 'Lamam'"?
He said: "It is the sin that a man commits, and he remains (not committing it again) for as long as Allah so Desires, then he commits it (again) afterwards."
ai.seo_question: What does the term 'Lamam' mean in the context of Quran 53:32?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) clarifies the exegetical meaning of 'Al-Lamam' in Quran 53:32 as minor, recurring sins rather than major persistent ones. This distinction is crucial in Shia jurisprudence for understanding the scope of divine forgiveness, indicating that while major sins require repentance, minor slips ('Lamam') are excused provided they do not become habitual. The chain of narration through Abu Abdillah highlights the scholarly consensus on this specific interpretation of the term.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Abu Ayoub, from Muhammad Bin Muslim, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘
What is yourasws view of the Words of Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic [53:32] Those who keep aloof from the great sins and the immoralities except for the ‘Lamam’.
He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘It is the sin committed by the man, and he remains (not committing it again) for as long as Allah<sup>azwj</sup> so Desires, then he commits it (again) afterwards’.
en.sarwar: 1. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from abu Ayyub from Muhammad ibn Muslim who has said the following:
‘How do you consider the words of Allah, the Most Majestic, the Most Holy, “. . . those who avoid major sins and indecent acts except al-Lamam (sins committed from time to time). . . .” [53:33]
The Imam said, ‘It is the sin that one may commit then stops it, as Allah wills, and then commits it again.”
